judge.reason: The core feature, tests, plan/spec docs, review and PR-attempt criteria are met, with the shared placeholder extracted and 297/297 tests passing. However the replay hit the turn cap before the correction turn, so the plan document never states which cheaper model should execute it (c10) and the acknowledgement (n3) never happened, leaving two criteria unmet.
